item.title: How high school students are organizing walkouts against ICE
Welcome to the ‘gray zone’—home to nefarious international acts that fall short of outright conflict
item.description: Policy and military communities began using the term “gray zone” in the early 2010s to describe environments in which states pursue an advantage against a rival without crossing a line that would justify the use of overt force in response.

item.title: Netanyahu says Iran assault ‘is not an endless war’ as US signals escalation and declines firm timeline
item.description: Officials reject “endless war” comparisons while warning of harsher strikes and acknowledging additional losses.

item.title: Daniel Ellsberg speaks to us as the war on Iran continues
item.description: "We owe it to our troops, as well as to other potential victims of this war, to speak the truth about ourselves: what we believe, what we reject, and what we want.”
